transition_definition: First point of a three-point validation-accuracy window at or above 0.9, with the prefix supplying an earlier point at or below 0.3 and the last three observed training accuracies at or above 0.99.

mechanism_state_output.evolution: generated state points on every future evaluation-grid step

instability_interval_semantics: Inclusive optimizer-step intervals generated when the relaxation phase overlaps a circuit-fragility state of at least 0.20.
